In order to verify our theoretical conclusions and un- cover other features of the parametric excitation of waves by an open-resonator-type transducer we performed a se- ries of micromagnetic simulations using MuMax3 solver [41].
please note, that simulation tem- perature in MuMax3 poorly describes real properties of thermal ﬁeld, and can be used for qualitative estimations, but not for the quantitative analysis

Certain discrepancy appears at large negative control electric ﬁeld and lower pumping frequency. This happens because the SW of the given frequency under the control gate enters into a deeply dipolar range (has low k), where the accuracy of Eq. (15) becomes insuﬃcient.
